sidecar_purpose: Repo-resident semantic image sidecar for GPT/worker selection, visual continuity, QA, and prompt constraint extraction.
source_truth_note: This sidecar is derived visual evidence for the referenced image. It does not by itself promote the image to canon beyond the acceptance state stated here.
runtime_use_note: Use this sidecar for ordinary textual selection and continuity work. Inspect the image pixels directly when exact composition, small text, proportions, or fine visual details matter.
do_not_infer_note: Do not infer unseen alternate views, additional props, story state, or acceptance of derivative images beyond what is described here.
summary: Approved hero image of Index carefully lifting and reviewing a parchment plan from a table stack. It is the clearest single-image reference for her source-first demeanor, faceplate, pencil-bun silhouette, cardigan texture, and archival document handling.

composition: Portrait-oriented image with Index occupying the left and center foreground.
Warm parchment-toned background with soft painterly texture and no hard scene clutter.
Index stands at a table or work surface on the lower right.
A layered stack of parchment plans and source papers lies on the table.
Index lifts the top sheet with both hands, bending it upward to inspect the content.
The composition focuses on careful retrieval and review rather than action spectacle.
character_design: Index has a large rounded pale faceplate with a thick cream rim.
Fixed circular eye surrounds are visible as two large pale rings on the faceplate.
Small purplish-pink eye marks sit low and to the side inside the eye surrounds, directed toward the lifted paper.
Tiny curved smile and small brow marks give a gentle, attentive, analytical expression.
Hair is dark indigo/blue-black and gathered into a high messy braided bun.
A yellow-orange pencil passes horizontally through the bun; red eraser end visible on one side and sharpened graphite tip visible on the other.
No antennae, no human ears, no human skin texture, and no literal human eyes.
costume: Bulky brown knit hooded cardigan with heavy woven texture, large cuffs, pockets, and visible buttons.
Hood is down, bunching around the shoulders and neck.
Beige/tan collared blouse visible under the cardigan, with small buttons down the front.
Dark charcoal trousers are partly visible below the blouse/cardigan.
Grounded dark shoes are visible at the bottom.
Hands are cream/off-white simplified autonomous-agent hands.
props_and_environment: Lifted parchment sheet contains faint diagrammatic markings, plans, and source notes.
Table stack includes multiple aged papers and folders with worn edges.
Small red paper tabs or markers are visible in the lower table stack.
The papers read as archival source material, plans, blueprints, or provenance records rather than magic scrolls or legal documents.
No computer, dashboard, legal seal, magic glow, field satchel, or terminal bag is present.
mood_and_role: Mood is calm, source-first, careful, and observant.
Index’s downward gaze is attention to evidence, not sadness or dejection.
The action shows retrieval and inspection of source documents.
The image reinforces Index as provenance/source specialist rather than decision-maker, lawyer, librarian, or explorer.
style: Clean Adventures editorial/vector-adjacent style with painterly shading.
Rounded readable linework and simplified forms.
Warm parchment and archive-paper color world.
Tactile textures on knit cardigan and aged papers.

Indigo messy top bun secured with pencils.
Dowdy brown hooded cardigan, beige/tan blouse, charcoal dark trousers, grounded dark shoes.
Compact grounded proportions; not tall human scale, not toy/chibi mascot scale.
Gentle, analytical, observant demeanor; attention is shown through eye position, not sadness.

Use this image as the primary hero cue for Index’s calm document-inspection posture.
Preserve the large faceplate, circular eye surrounds, purplish-pink movable eye marks, and pencil-bun silhouette.
